# Quantum Thermometry Feedback — reading routes

Question: global minimax squared log-temperature error with two fresh-Gibbs preparation batches, one classical Hamiltonian update and a pathwise N-qubit budget.
Main theorem: R_2^*(N)=Theta(N^(-3/2)). The general fixed-r statement is a lower bound, not a matching hierarchy.

OVERVIEW: README.md — question, result, resources and navigation.
STUDY: learning/README.md — shared learning route.
SINGLE ANCHOR: learning/ANCHOR.md — De Pasquale and Stace, Quantum Thermometry, arXiv:1807.05762v1 (2018); verified page/equation pointers, notation and scope bridge.
CONCEPTUAL MAP: learning/MILESTONES.md — exactly M01–M30, with 14 background and 16 narrative targets; dependencies and canonical scientific sources.
WORKED EXPLANATION: learning/TUTORIAL.md — counting, global loss, 256-qubit example, posterior obstruction and rare-error accounting.
MODEL: science/model.md — full replacement, energy-label sufficiency, feedback and quantum memory.
FOUNDATION: science/entropy_budget.md — integrated sensitivity area and pointwise heat capacity.
CONVERSE: science/two_batch_converse.md — posterior Fisher identity, posterior peak, van Trees.
CONSTRUCTION: science/achievability.md — pilot, tuned degenerate blocks, smoothed logit, exponential moment.
ROUNDS: science/round_complexity.md — fixed-r lower bounds and necessary log-log depth only.
PHYSICAL MEANING: science/interpretation.md — sensitivity bandwidth and unpaid implementation costs.
ATTRIBUTION: references/RELATED_WORK.md and references/references.bib — inherited ingredients, comparisons and literature-access limits.
REPRODUCE: verification/README.md, verification/checks.py and verification/learning_checks.py.

Do not conflate mean-square error with root error, local sensitivity with global risk, Gibbs qubit uses with elapsed time, or a converse with attainment. The authoritative mathematical claims are in science/. Personal tutorial procedures and learner records are not part of this repository.
